alexAi.openRouterApiKey.markdownDescription:
**Required**: Your OpenRouter API key for AI responses.

Get your API key at [openrouter.ai](https://openrouter.ai/keys)

⚠️ This key is stored in VS Code settings. Never share it publicly.

enumDescriptions: ⚡ Commander Riker - Crew coordinator (RECOMMENDED - routes to optimal crew)

alexAi.defaultCrewMember.markdownDescription: Default crew member. **Riker recommended** - he coordinates the crew and routes queries to optimal specialists while optimizing costs with Quark.

alexAi.autoLoadContext.markdownDescription: Automatically include current file context when chatting with crew members

alexAi.openChatOnStartup.markdownDescription: Automatically open Alex AI chat panel when VS Code starts

alexAi.setAsDefaultChatAgent.markdownDescription: Set Alex AI as the preferred chat agent (pre-selects @alex in chat)

alexAi.enableInlineCompletions.markdownDescription: Enable AI-powered code completions (like GitHub Copilot)

alexAi.enableHoverExplanations.markdownDescription: Show AI explanations when hovering over code symbols

alexAi.enableCodeReview.markdownDescription: Automatically review code and show suggestions in Problems panel (on save)

alexAi.autoDetectSelection.markdownDescription: Automatically detect text selection in editor and prepare it as context for crew chat

alexAi.baseUrl.markdownDescription:
Base URL for Alex AI API server.

- **Production** (default): `https://rag.pbradygeorgen.com`
- **Local development**: `http://localhost:3000`

Change this to your local URL when developing or to a custom deployment URL.

alexAi.autoApproveFileEdits.description: Automatically apply file edits proposed by Alex AI chat without confirmation.

alexAi.enableChatFileTools.description: Enable Alex AI chat to propose filesystem operations (write/patch) via alexfs blocks.

alexAi.alwaysShowDiffPreview.description: Show a diff preview before applying file edits, even when auto-approve is enabled.

alexAi.fsWritableRoots.description: Workspace-relative root folders that Alex AI chat is allowed to write/patch/delete within.

alexAi.allowChatDeletes.description: Allow Alex AI chat to delete files via filesystem tools (dangerous).

alexAi.enableHotReload.markdownDescription:
**Development Mode**: Enable hot reload to automatically sync with web dashboard.

⚡ Real-time updates when projects, crew status, or metrics change.

⚠️ Only enable during development - polls server every 5 seconds.

alexAi.hotReloadInterval.markdownDescription:
Hot reload polling interval in milliseconds (1000-60000).

Default: 5000ms (5 seconds)

alexAi.enableSprintAutoRefresh.markdownDescription:
**Sprint Timeline**: Automatically refresh sprint data at regular intervals.

✅ Keeps sprint board up-to-date with latest changes

⚠️ Sends API request every 30 seconds (configurable)

alexAi.sprintRefreshInterval.markdownDescription:
Sprint auto-refresh interval in milliseconds (5000-300000).

Default: 30000ms (30 seconds)
